messages:
sara: proposing a single 'risk_index' gate for v4q-longchat bring-up. goal: combine fidelity + latency + infra-stability so we can do conservative auto-fallbacks without an explosion of ad-hoc rules.

devin: +1. what signals feed the index?

sara: concordance delta (vs v3 baseline) for quality, named-entity halluc rate, p99 latency absolute and pct-uplift, and cache_eviction_rate (kv-warmup issues show up there). normalize each and score 0..1. trigger if risk_index>=0.75 sustained.

kai: add answer_length_drift too — v4 tends to produce longer outputs which increases cost and latency; that can be correlated with hallucination.

olga: can you drop a compact policy blob so routing can consume it? keep it minimal.

sara: pasted below; it's intentionally terse for the orchestration API. note: this is just the staging draft.

```json
{
  "policy_name":"risk_index_v1",
  "inputs":["concordance_delta","ner_halluc_pct","latency_p99_ms","latency_pct_uplift","cache_eviction_pct","answer_len_delta"],
  "weights":{"concordance_delta":0.4,"ner_halluc_pct":0.2,"latency_p99_ms":0.15,"latency_pct_uplift":0.1,"cache_eviction_pct":0.1,"answer_len_delta":0.05},
  "norm":"robust_minmax",
  "latency":{"abs_p99_ms":450,"pct_uplift_threshold":0.2},
  "trigger":{
    "alert_score":0.6,
    "auto_score":0.75,
    "alert_window_min":10,
    "auto_window_min":3
  },
  "preconds":{"min_canary_pct":2.0,"min_slices_firing":2},
  "context_adjustments":[{"if":"seq_len>2048","apply":{"weights_mul":{"latency_p99_ms":1.5,"concordance_delta":0.85}}}],
  "actions":{"on_alert":["notify:#eng-ml","attach_timeseries:[per_signal]"],"on_auto":["rollback","create_incident:severity=high"]}
}
```

devin: nit: cache_eviction_pct unit? use evictions_per_1k_requests to avoid weird percent math. also prefer a small synthetic eval set focusing on long multi-turn dialogs to surface concordance regressions faster.

sara: good point. will change metric to evictions_per_1k. and yes synthetic set + a shadow sample of 200 customer long-docs.

mira: ops request: require either canary_pct>=2% OR >=3 independent slices firing to enable auto rollback. otherwise just fire an Ops alert. noisy tiny cohorts cause false autos.

kai: also suggest keeping auto_score conservative for first 24h (0.85) and lower to 0.75 after a 'soft-watch' period. we can automate that with a time-based multiplier.

olga: console ask: can we show the per-signal contribution as a stacked bar and the running risk_index so oncall understands drivers at glance?

sara: telemetry team exposes per-signal series; devex just needs to compute weighted contributions client-side. I'll coordinate the spec.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary start for model:v4q-longchat at 2026-03-23T17:12:00Z cohort=0.5%. hooks: concordance_delta, ner_halluc_pct, latency_p99_ms, latency_pct_uplift, evictions_per_1k, answer_len_delta.

mira: starting shadow run on synthetic longchat set now. will post a 20m snapshot.

sara: plan: push risk_index_v1 to staging with alert_score=0.6 (10m), auto_score=0.85 (3m) for first 24h, require (canary_pct>=2% OR slices>=3) for auto. tag @eng-ml for smoke tomorrow morning.

devin: thanks — and add an opt-in debug dump that includes per-request signal values for the canary cohort to help triage if we see a trigger.

sara: will do. posting the staged config link when pushed. cheers everyone :rocket:
